influences.project_interpretation: External agent-harness ideas inform the operating model, but user-confirmed card quality rules are the final authority for this workspace.

operating_model.progressive_disclosure: Read the smallest relevant spec subset, escalate only when the task crosses product, content, interaction, or box boundaries.
guardrails: content-quality blockers
sample before batch
user-only final approval
legacy status demotion
tts text/audio separation
formal audio readiness requires audio generation contract and reviews/audio_qc record
no harness and bulk-content mixed PR
recorded upstream catalog alignment issues
read-only card quality audit for legacy and candidate corpus risk signals
card quality audit reports must match the current card corpus fingerprint
sample and approval records must link the current card quality audit report
candidate sample PRs use scoped audit reports under reviews/audit_scopes instead of committing global report refreshes
content sample PRs must not carry global report refreshes or non-scope self-review fingerprint churn
content sample PRs must replay the current scoped card quality audit before accepting changed scoped-audit evidence

all cards that carry quality_metadata must use schema and content-quality enums; untouched legacy cards may omit metadata, but any added or modified candidate card must pass current complete metadata validation without grandfathering
all files consumed under card_boxes_json use the canonical governed filename, and changed candidate cards are derived from NUL-delimited merge-base-to-head card objects rather than declared scope

every JSON change under agent_self_review, drafts, or audit_scopes triggers content-candidate validation without relying on a filename prefix; only exact repository-declared template paths are excluded
current scoped audits materialize the complete immutable HEAD card_boxes_json tree so deleted or renamed base paths cannot leak into the replay

each changed candidate requires exactly one changed review coverage; standard self-review entries are compared with their unique HEAD corpus card even when the card did not change, and quality_metadata deeply matches every field except the independently validated artifact-local review_status

full-track remediation records are aggregate human-review evidence with no cards property; strict equal non-empty unique scope and coverage IDs must equal the complete declared track card and box-prefix sets in immutable HEAD, and merge-base plus HEAD track membership must be the same non-empty set so aggregate coverage cannot authorize added cards

changed elimination cards use explicit unique elimination_items IDs, ID-based answer_key.correct_items, and a temporary eliminable_items text/is_correct preview projection; untouched legacy text-as-ID migrations remain read-only compatibility only
multi-prefix content PRs require explicit handoff or residual-closure evidence proving a single review unit
residual blocker closure reviews are not 3-card sample approvals and must not recommend user confirmation
agent-managed git lifecycle for tracked-file changes

git handoffs exclude only the exact repository-declared handoff template path, require fatal byte-preserving UTF-8 decoding including leading U+FEFF and no-ignore gitlink discovery for Git paths, bind the complete payload path set and optional literal-pathspec patch digest to the final payload commit, read the handoff from the explicit HEAD snapshot, and audit the full reachable post-payload commit set including merged side histories so a reverted mutation or identical-tree merge still fails

git-diff-binary-v2 patch evidence uses the authority-declared deterministic environment, Git config, diff options, and commit-sourced attributes; non-empty repository info attributes or custom diff-driver config fail closed
real pull-request handoffs use /pull URLs while parked no-PR handoffs use clearly identified /compare locators
the GitHub delivery-record gate validates the exact pull_request head SHA while other pull-request jobs preserve synthetic merge coverage
hint_layer enhancement is not a standalone card interaction
sample quality gate links quality metadata, blocker scan, self-review, and user approval records
